Name: Let Me Shop
Author: MindMeltMax
Description:
This was requested by [url=https://github.com/StardewSweetheart]StardewSweetHeart[/url] on the [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/1094]Stardew mod idea's GitHub[/url].
﻿
It's going to allow you to both buy stuff from Clint and process geodes while your tools are upgrading.
Being able to process geodes can be toggled on or off.

[size=5][b]How to install : [/b][/size]
1. Install [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]Smapi[/url]﻿
2. Unzip the file and place it in the mod folder

[url=https://github.com/MindMeltMax/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/main/LetMeShop][Source Code][/url]

Manifest.Name: Let Me Shop
Manifest.Description: Allows you to still process geodes and shop while upgrading tools
